animal_cow_mastitis.title: ଗାଈ ମାଷ୍ଟାଇଟିସ
animal_cow_mastitis.overview: Mastitis is an infection of the udder causing swelling, clotted milk, fever, and reduced milk output.
animal_cow_mastitis.treatment_organic: Wash udder with warm saline; apply turmeric + aloe vera paste; use neem warm compress twice daily.
animal_cow_mastitis.treatment_chemical: Consult a veterinarian for intramammary antibiotics and anti-inflammatory injections.
animal_cow_mastitis.prevention: Maintain strict milking hygiene, clean bedding, dry housing, and post-milking teat dipping.
animal_cow_mastitis.immediate_steps: Isolate the cow, discard milk safely, and consult a veterinarian immediately.

animal_goat_healthy.title: ବାଁ ସ୍ୱସ୍ଥ
animal_goat_healthy.overview: No disease symptoms detected. The goat appears healthy based on the uploaded image.
animal_goat_healthy.prevention: Maintain vaccination, clean shelter, proper nutrition, and regular deworming.
animal_goat_healthy.immediate_steps: Continue daily care and monitor for any unusual symptoms.

animal_goat_ppr.title: ବାଁରେ PPR
animal_goat_ppr.overview: PPR is a contagious viral disease causing fever, mouth ulcers, nasal discharge, diarrhea, and pneumonia.
animal_goat_ppr.treatment_organic: Provide warm water, electrolyte solution, and herbal immune boosters. Ensure isolation.
animal_goat_ppr.treatment_chemical: No direct antiviral cure. Supportive care + vet-prescribed drugs to prevent secondary infections.
animal_goat_ppr.prevention: Annual vaccination, quarantine new animals for 14 days, disinfect housing.
animal_goat_ppr.immediate_steps: Isolate the goat immediately and contact a veterinarian urgently.

plant_paddy_blast.title: ଧାନ ବ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟ
plant_paddy_blast.overview: Caused by Magnaporthe oryzae, blast results in diamond-shaped lesions and severe yield losses.
plant_paddy_blast.treatment_organic: Apply neem + garlic botanical extract; use fermented buttermilk spray; remove infected leaves.
plant_paddy_blast.treatment_chemical: Spray Tricyclazole, Propiconazole, or Carbendazim per local guidelines.
plant_paddy_blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties, avoid excess nitrogen, maintain moderate irrigation and good airflow.
plant_paddy_blast.immediate_steps: Spray recommended fungicide and notify local agricultural extension.

plant_paddy_blight.title: ଧାନ ବ୍ଲାଇଟ୍
plant_paddy_blight.overview: Caused by Xanthomonas oryzae, leading to leaf drying, yellowing, and rapid crop decline.
plant_paddy_blight.treatment_organic: Apply cow urine-based foliar spray or panchagavya; remove infected plants.
plant_paddy_blight.treatment_chemical: Copper oxychloride or Streptocycline as recommended.
plant_paddy_blight.prevention: Use disease-free seeds, maintain drainage, apply balanced nutrients.
plant_paddy_blight.immediate_steps: Clear infected patches and consult local agri officer for bactericide use.

plant_paddy_brownspot.title: ଧାନ ବ୍ରାଉନ୍ ସ୍ପଟ୍
plant_paddy_brownspot.overview: Brown spot lesions appear due to Bipolaris oryzae and poor soil nutrition.
plant_paddy_brownspot.treatment_organic: Use seaweed extract, compost tea; improve soil potassium organically.
plant_paddy_brownspot.treatment_chemical: Spray Mancozeb or Carbendazim depending on severity.
plant_paddy_brownspot.prevention: Ensure potassium-rich fertilization and use treated seeds.
plant_paddy_brownspot.immediate_steps: Apply recommended fungicide and improve soil nutrient balance.

plant_paddy_tungro.title: ଧାନ ଟାଙ୍ଗ୍ରୋ
plant_paddy_tungro.overview: Viral disease spread by leafhoppers causing orange discoloration, stunting, and low tillering.
plant_paddy_tungro.treatment_organic: Remove infected plants and use neem oil sprays to reduce vectors.
plant_paddy_tungro.treatment_chemical: Control leafhopper vectors with recommended insecticides (e.g., Imidacloprid).
plant_paddy_tungro.prevention: Use resistant varieties, synchronize planting, and manage weeds.
plant_paddy_tungro.immediate_steps: Rogue infected plants and spray for vector control immediately.
